notes: No Cliopatria row. REPAIR of 2026-11-01 (review g-sa-a, verdict fail): (1) the capital Dimapur was outside the 1526-1557 shapes because the subtracted Ahom Jorhat 110 km disc contains it; the disc is now taken without a Dimapur 30 km disc in keyframes 1-3, ledger 1-4, ledger 6 (1644) and the first war's zone (cells 118, 63, 77 for keyframes 1-3 instead of 113, 58, 72). (2) The 14 hill cells that keyframe 3 added without an event are now a 1558 gain from nobody (confidence 2; the page is silent on earlier control of the North Cachar hills). (3) The Koch feudatory status is now a vassal_start 1564 / vassal_end 1587 pair against koch-bihar (the end is a bridge at confidence 1). NOT RESOLVED: the Burmese occupation of Cachar and Govinda Chandra's restoration (the Kachari page: 'came under Burmese occupation in the late early 19th-century'; 'restored by the British after the Yandabo Treaty in 1826'; the Burmese invasions of Assam page is silent on Cachar), and the founding year (Kachari and Dimasa people pages silent). OPEN FOR OTHER DOSSIERS (not edited here): ahom-kingdom must take the Dimapur 30 km disc (93.73E 25.91N) out of its Jorhat 110 km disc in keyframes 1526-1638 and ledger 6-7, otherwise the compile gives the capital to both; koch-bihar needs a vassal_start 1564 / vassal_end with this slug as counterpart and a loss of the Barak valley in 1745 (to the Kachari kingdom) or to khaspur-state; east-india-company ledger 68 and 72 name 'Dimasa Kachari kingdom of Cachar (no dossier)': re-point to kachari-kingdom. START: the page gives no founding date; 1228 is a bridge at confidence 1 (the earliest dated evidence is a coin of 1520), and kamarupa-kingdom lists this state as a successor at 1140, so 1140-1228 is unmapped. REGIONS: every Kachari disc before 1536 is the researcher's reading of 'between the Dikhu and the Kolong' with the Ahom dossier's Jorhat and Nagaon discs for the lost lands; the ahom-kingdom keyframes for 1523-1525 (Dibrugarh 170 km) already contain most of the Jorhat disc, so the Kachari shape subtracts the Dibrugarh disc. The 1526 loss and contest_start share one region. THE PAGE'S CONTRADICTIONS: 'Dimarua in Nagaon district' was Kachari under Satrudaman (1618) although the Ahoms held the Kolong country from 1536; Govinda Chandra's domain annexed 1833 (body) against 1832 (infobox); Khaspur capital 1745/1750/1755; the Suhungmung page says the Kachari kingdom 'abandoned Dimapur permanently' in 1536 while the Ahom page says the occupations did not annex it (the shape keeps Dimapur, as the Ahom page). RULERS: the page names rulers without a full list; no ruler strip. Gazetteer names needed: Dimapur, Maibang (places; regions here use coordinates).
